fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships

comentarios.texto: `group.users.delete(user_id)` with a raw integer id looks the record up through the association and raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound if the user is not (or is no longer) a member. This happens when two admins remove the same member, or on a stale member list, and it returns a 500/404 instead of succeeding silently. Look the user up first and delete it only if it is present in the group.

comentarios.texto: WHAT: The NPE fix is applied only to getSubGroupsCount, so the three getSubGroupsStream overloads still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) without a null check. WHY: modelSupplier.get() returns null when the group is deleted concurrently, so those paths still throw NullPointerException. HOW: Guard them the same way, for example by returning Stream.empty() when the delegate is null.

The docstrings say validate_timestamp checks that 'age is absent, but timestamp is present' and validate_age checks that 'age is present, but not timestamp'. The code only rejects the case where both fields are supplied. Both fields are required=False, so a report with neither passes. Reword the docstrings to say they only enforce mutual exclusion, or add a check that one of the two is present.

comentarios.texto: The module docstring and key glossary still describe `span-buf:s:*` as plain sets and say the payload is simply added to the set. After this change the keys are sorted sets scored by `end_timestamp_precise`, and `add-buffer.lua` trims each one to 1000 spans, popping the lowest scores. Update the docstring to say sorted sets, the score, and the 1000-span cap.
